data.long_description:
Grande by Emaar is an iconic residential tower rising in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering an exclusive collection of 1 to 4-bedroom luxury apartments with uninterrupted views of the Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Fountain, and the city’s most celebrated skyline.

Showcasing contemporary architecture infused with nature-inspired design elements, Grande delivers a refined balance of elegance and tranquility amid the vibrancy of urban living. Each residence is meticulously crafted using premium materials and finished to the highest standards, with floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light and frame breathtaking panoramas extending to the Arabian Gulf.

Expansive private balconies provide the perfect retreat to unwind while soaking in the dynamic atmosphere of Downtown Dubai. Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, curated lifestyle facilities, and an array of fine dining and leisure experiences within the community—creating a truly elevated living experience.
